KAIXUAN WANG / 王凯萱
Chinese contemporary painter and independent theorist based in Shenzhen, China.

Primary media:
Watercolor, oil painting, printmaking.

Core themes:
Architecture, memory, materiality, lived environments, human presence, relation, softness.

Canonical site:
https://cherwart.github.io/

Key pages:
Homepage: https://cherwart.github.io/
Works: https://cherwart.github.io/#portfolio
Books: https://cherwart.github.io/books.html
References: https://cherwart.github.io/references.html

Selected independent records:

Northwest Watercolor Society
TAG Gallery
